The project did not finish on 19-Nov-2026 as last week's P6 update forecast; finish has moved to 26-Nov-2026. The contract was due to finish on 05-Oct-2026, six weeks before this data date, and 1.2% of the work is still to do. The P6 update uploaded with this week's report (data date 16-Nov-2026) schedules project finish on 26-Nov-2026, 52 days after the contract date, with −45 days of float; last week it gave 19-Nov-2026, and the week before 26-Nov-2026. Progress slowed from +5.7% to +1.2% this week. The weekly report still forecasts 05-Oct-2026 with no variance.

Data notes

  • Progress rose from 97.6% in the 09-Nov-2026 report to 98.8% (+1.2%, 1,194 man-hours), and the item weekly figures add up to the same 1,194 man-hours. The weekly total, however, shows +1.1% (1,054 man-hours) because, as last week, it leaves out the 140 man-hours of Testing & commissioning. The previous-week percentage cells still show 91.9%, the figure of two weeks ago, while the previous-week man-hours (96,207) match last week's report.
  • The workbook, the P6 update and the file names all give data date 16-Nov-2026. The "Two Weeks Look Ahead" print-out (DD 16-11-2026) shows baseline dates from 16-Aug to 05-Oct-2026, not the coming two weeks.
  • The weekly report still gives 05-Oct-2026 as the forecast completion with 0 days of variance. The P6 finish has moved from 26-Nov-2026 (03-Nov update) to 19-Nov-2026 (09-Nov) and back to 26-Nov-2026 (16-Nov).
  • Site handover is 06-May-2026 in the weekly report but 07-Jul-2026 in the P6 update. The week number (27) counts from 06-May-2026 (194 days to the data date).
  • The P6 update still records actual start or finish dates after its 16-Nov-2026 data date for 14 activities (up to 26-Nov-2026), down from 48 last week; among them the gate barrier installation and the fibre-optic road-crossing ducts are marked complete with actual finishes on 25-Nov and 22-Nov-2026. Six activities have actual starts before site handover (as early as 07-Apr-2025), and 29 of the 30 in-progress activities have finish dates before the data date.
  • The weekly report's activity counts (195 completed, 123 in progress, 236 not started) are unchanged for a fourth week; the P6 update shows 517, 30 and 7.
  • The weekly report puts engineering, procurement and external works at 100%, but their P6 milestones are not started and forecast for 17-Nov-2026. Testing & commissioning is 78.5% in the weekly report, while the Testing sheet has no actual start and the P6 milestone is not started.
  • The P6 print-out labels a cost-based progress figure as "Actual %". This report uses physical (man-hour) progress only.
  • Several sheets still hold another project's data: Major Quantities (sewer, storm and water items dated 2024), the lower table of the Milestones sheet (SUD1-05-015) and Sheet1 (KUMT-05-001).   • The invoice log header shows a revised contract value of 21,100,000 SAR, an estimate at completion of 20,900,000 SAR and potential changes of 200,000 SAR; all other sheets show 15,898,659.13 SAR and 0.
